limitations: The development fixture draws actual production React components and CSS but no 3D scene.
Fullscreen and Pointer Lock require real trusted browser gestures here; display dimensions remain the requested emulated viewport.
This checks geometry/accessibility of named essential HUD rows, long custom titles and an actual active flash cue; it is not a font-size or physical-device usability study.

tasks: scenario with64-character literal Korean custom title
flash with actual first active exercise cue

fixtureChanges: Import premium.css and operator.css after styles/tokens/tactical, matching production global stylesheet order.
Enable physicsDiagnostics to make all four essential rows measurable.
Use a real jump/landing in the frozen fixture.
Stop flash simulation at its first actual active cue instead of assuming a cue remains active at300ticks.
Use actual simulation.time for the task countdown so an active flash cue is not shown alongside a synthetic expired timer.
harnessCorrection: Initial fullscreen probe walked clipping ancestors above the top-layer fullscreen element and incorrectly treated its zero-height body as a clip. Corrected traversal stops at document.fullscreenElement; no production CSS change was needed. Raw initial probe retained at /workspace/roadmap-qa/stage3-hud-layout-initial-probe.json.
